EXPLANATION: The intense 2232 cm⁻¹ band is a C≡N stretch (GFQ-009). The strong 1587 cm⁻¹ band fits an aromatic C=C mode region (GFQ-010), and 3073 cm⁻¹ corresponds to aromatic C–H stretching (GFQ-003). Crucially, the 645 cm⁻¹ peak is characteristic for aryl C–Br stretching, supporting a bromobenzonitrile over other nitrile candidates (no OH/NH stretches seen, excluding hydroxy/amine derivatives). The 775 cm⁻¹ and 1071–1197 cm⁻¹ bands are consistent with substituted benzene ring deformation/breathing modes. Overall, these features best match N#Cc1ccc(Br)cc1.
